lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I have a plan to beat Buu.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm gonna use the Spirit Bomb.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You used it on me — didn't work.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You used it on Freeza — didn't work!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And you didn't even bother using it on Cell!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, yeah, because I knew it wouldn't work.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: But it will this time, though.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: But if this doesn't work, I will kill you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If this doesn't work, Buu will kill you.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And I will drag you to hell with me!
